main_body: A snow-capped wooden frame or stall with a grey post frame and tan planks or crates inset on the front, topped by a thick snow roof.
top_band: Rows ~1-7: white and pale blue-grey snow, lightest at the top and shading to blue-grey toward the front edge, then an icicle row at ~8-10.
evidence: Down the middle column the snow cap is several rows of light tone. A blue-grey step with icicles marks the front edge and shades the face just below it. The grey front face (rows ~10-25) holds planks set between dark frame bars, so it reads as inset. The projection is correct 3/4. The object is a stall or crate-like prop, not an organic object such as a plant or rock, so the caller's kind label does not fit, and I fail it for that.

style.evidence: The snow has about 4 steps of white and blue-grey with some icicle detail. The tan plank blocks are large, nearly flat fills with only a few dark lines, and the grey frame sides are flat as well. The outlines are a mix of dark grey and brown with little material tint. Next to the stall and well references it carries fewer colours per tile and less grain, so it looks thinner.
